fact_summary: For 2026–2027, full-time professional master's tuition is USD 30,720 per semester; approved part-time tuition is USD 2,560 per credit. Thirty credits and a typical three-semester duration do not establish a mandatory billing schedule. The online MCS rate of USD 1,700 per credit is a different modality.
locator: Fall 2026 / Spring 2027 Professional Masters in Engineering
